resources.string: Temperature and weather for your location, and the planes flying over

1. Tap Activate Glyph Toy and add "Weather & Flights".
2. Go to Settings › Glyph Interface › Flip to Glyph › Always-on Glyph Toy and choose Weather & Flights.
3. Put the phone face down.

The matrix shows the temperature for 30 seconds, then an animated weather icon for 3 seconds. The weather refreshes every 30 minutes. Opening this app also updates your location.

When a plane flies within 5 km, it crosses the matrix in the direction it's heading, then its flight, route, aircraft type, airline and speed scroll past 4 times, then its altitude (35K = 35,000 ft).
Location permission is needed to know where you are.
